components.name: KnockoutBracket
components.doc: Single-elimination bracket: pick a winner and it travels along its connector into the next round.

members.name: id
members.doc: Unique id, used in the picks.

members.name: code
members.doc: Three-letter code, shown instead of the name when the bracket is narrow.

members.name: seed
members.doc: Seed number shown before the name. Auto-fill favours the lower seed.

types.name: BracketPicks
types.doc: Winner of each decided match: match id (`round-index`, both from zero) to team id.

members.name: teams
members.doc: Teams in bracket order: the first two meet in the first match, and so on. The count must be a power of two. Defaults to eight sample clubs.

members.name: value
members.doc: Picked winners. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the bracket.

members.name: onValueChange
members.doc: Called with all picks after one changes. Picks that no longer follow from earlier rounds are already removed.
